analysis.title: ON Semiconductor Corp. (ON): First Take: Solid quarter and guidance; acquires Ferric
key_insights: GS expects ON stock to be range bound after 3Q26 revenue and EPS in line with the Street and 4Q guidance just above the Street.
onsemi will acquire Ferric, a provider of power solutions for AI infrastructure, for $600mn in cash.
GS sees investor expectations as balanced heading into the print, with datacenter power strength set against outsized automotive exposure.

Call focus areas: datacenter power progress toward the target of doubling revenue in 2026 and 2027, automotive demand trends after constructive TI and NXP commentary, the pending Synaptics acquisition and its effect on financial targets, and initial 2027 business trends.
GS expects a neutral reaction across the analog group because most peers have already reported. The most direct read-across is to ADI (Buy) given its relatively high automotive exposure.

3Q26 revenue was $1.72 bn, in line with GS at $1.72 bn and the Street at $1.71 bn. Gross margin was 41.2% vs 41.1% for both GS and the Street. EPS was $0.90, in line with GS and above the Street at $0.88.
4Q26 guidance midpoint: revenue $1.77 bn (GS $1.79 bn, Street $1.74 bn), gross margin 42.5% (GS 42.5%, Street 42.1%), adjusted EPS $0.95-$1.07 with a $1.01 midpoint (GS $1.02, Street $0.95).
GS keeps a Neutral rating and a $95 12-month target, based on 20x P/E applied to normalized EPS of $4.75. The stock was $71.67 at the 30 Oct 2026 close, implying 32.6% upside to the target.

market_movers.rationale: Routine post-earnings reiteration. 3Q26 was in line and 4Q guidance sits slightly above the Street, with GS expecting a range-bound stock. The target uses 20x P/E on normalized EPS of $4.75.
Named as the most direct read-across from ON's results because of its relatively high automotive exposure. The report gives a Buy rating and a $417.11 price in its disclosures.

sector_views.rationale: GS expects a neutral reaction for the analog group because most peers have already reported.

earnings_insights: ON 3Q26 revenue reported $1.72 bn vs GS est $1.72 bn and Street (Visible Alpha) consensus est $1.71 bn. Exhibit 1 shows Street at $1,706 mn, +11.1% YoY and +7.4% QoQ.
ON 3Q26 gross margin (excl. SBC) reported 41.2% vs GS est 41.1% and Street consensus est 41.1%.
ON 3Q26 EPS (incl. SBC) reported $0.90 vs GS est $0.90 and Street consensus est $0.88.
ON 4Q26 guidance: revenue midpoint $1.77 bn (range $1,715 mn-$1,815 mn) vs GS est $1.79 bn and Street consensus est $1.74 bn. Exhibit 2 shows Street at $1,737 mn.
ON 4Q26 gross margin guidance (excl. SBC) midpoint 42.5% vs GS est 42.5% and Street consensus est 42.1%.
ON 4Q26 adjusted EPS guidance $0.95-$1.07, midpoint $1.01, vs GS est $1.02 and Street consensus est $0.95. Exhibit 2 labels the EPS basis as incl. SBC.
GS EPS estimates: $0.74 for 6/26 (actual), $0.90 for 9/26E, $1.02 for 12/26E, $1.03 for 3/27E. Full-year EPS is $2.35 for 2025, then $3.30, $4.59 and $5.60 for 2026E-2028E.
risk_factors: Demand weakness, particularly in the Automotive end market, could drive downside.
Gross margin execution and the timing of self-help initiatives could drive earnings upside or downside.
Outsized automotive exposure was cited as a counterweight to datacenter power strength.
vol_and_positioning: GS expects ON to be range bound after the print.
GS M&A Rank for ON is 3, a low 0%-15% probability of becoming an acquisition target, and is not factored into the price target.
